local_execution_resources: cached Linux runner image, dedicated named network and per-slot PostgreSQL/Redis resources; no host ports
backup: two separately versioned local roots using the existing OfflineCloud implementation; both real PostgreSQL dumps, archive/member verification; does not requalify S3

cases.proof: specific b3-evidence refusal, raw FAILED retained, complete 600s, unchanged outcome values, verified backup followed by actual next-slot driver admission
saved-order next admission after prior verified backup, normal driver, full 600s and verified backup
named CALIBRATION_TECHNICAL_DEFECT after real driver returns; real exception and durable pause; backup retained and sentinel next slot rejected
stop collector at checkpoint after two polls, retain live services, same-boot attach to original execution/deadline; no driver or POST commands replayed; finish original 600s and verify backup

stopping_criteria: Finite checks only. Retain every attempt. Stop live admissions on unplanned technical failure, source drift, active RAM below 1GiB, disk below 10GiB, or total local wall budget expiry. Do not enlarge the set or observation windows. All four planned results and required offline gates must PASS before recommending review; no main freeze/launch capabilities created.
